I checked the proposal and rewrote one paragraph. `text-check.mjs` flagged nothing.

The "Why" paragraph packed the owner's three asks into one dense run. I split it into three bold bullets: coverage 100%, one refiner, and lessons first. The edit is in `one-refiner-plan/requirements.md`, and I logged a "rewrote" line in `flags.jsonl`. I didn't check whether an agent still owns this task, so I applied the edit directly rather than sending it to one.
